items.claim: fixed d-collapse-under-lock: Shift-press that reads as replace still defers under `extendClickLocked`, so release collapses
fixed deferred collapse uses the release's modifiers, so Shift/Cmd pressed before release toggles instead of collapsing, lock or not

items.note: The "lifecycle options" in A's title are not a defect: `label`/`transient`/`onRunStart`/`onRunEnd` describe the move run, and putting a move's label or callbacks on a clone would be wrong. The `MoveOptions.dragThresholdPx` doc in core now names the clone bindings too.

items.claim: fixed `pickTolerance` documented as silhouette-only though the `'aabb'` picker reads it around a derived route's box
items.note: This was a doc defect, so no test could fail before the fix. The new test pins the behavior the doc now describes: a straight route under `'aabb'` is hit within `pickTolerance`.

`UseImageToolOptions` now takes only `behaviors` from `InsertToolOptions`. A `@ts-expect-error` test failed typecheck before the fix. The changeset is `major` + `breaking fix`, because code that passed `share` stops compiling. Sweep: every other insert tool (rect, ellipse, line, polygon, star, pencil, text, sticky) honors `share`.
